additions.reason: Moshe is explicitly equated with Da'at in this Torah — 'Moshe Rabbeinu, she-hu bechina Da'at.' Da'at belongs to the mochin cluster (upper intellect). Moshe is the embodiment of Torah-revelation (Da'at), and the teaching centers on him as the archetypal figure of Torah-disclosure. Belongs in the Mochin/Chokhmah package.
additions.source_quote: מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּנוּ... שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת דַּעַת, כִּי הַתּוֹרָה נִקְרָא רֵאשִׁית דַּעַת

additions.reason: Da'at is called the bechina of Moshe and the bechina of Torah ('Torah nikra reishit da'at'). It is the third of the upper mochin (Chokhmah, Binah, Da'at). The Torah treats Da'at as the unifying mochin that allows grasping the Tzaddik's speech — directly parallel to the role of mochin in this Torah. Belongs in the Mochin/Chokhmah package.

Torah is called 'reishit da'at' (beginning of knowledge/da'at) — a bechina statement equating Torah with Da'at, which is part of the mochin cluster. The Torah's entire argument is that Torah-revelation IS the birth of the mochin. Torah is also described as having 70 faces, rooted in the 70 souls of Beit Yaakov — the same bechina structure as the mochin. Belongs in the Mochin/Chokhmah package.

Lilith is explicitly identified as the spleen (טחול) — 'she-hi Lilith, she-hi Shifha Bisha.' Since טחול is already in the evil kingdom package, Lilith must be added as a direct bechina of it. This is a bechina node (shared essential nature) belonging to the evil kingdom cluster.
additions.source_quote: תַּאֲוַת נִאוּף הִיא בָּאָה מֵעֲכִירַת דָּמִים, הַיְנוּ מִטְּחוֹל, שֶׁהִיא לִילִית, שֶׁהִיא שִׁפְחָה בִּישָׁא

additions.reason: The 'evil maidservant' is equated with Lilith, with the spleen, with malkhut haReshaya, and with the erev rav. It is the evil feminine archetype — the direct counterpart (evil mirror) of the 'Gevirah/Isha Yirat Hashem' in Package 1. Explicit bechina: 'she-hi Lilith, she-hi Shifha Bisha.' Belongs in the evil kingdom package.
additions.source_quote: שֶׁהִיא לִילִית, שֶׁהִיא שִׁפְחָה בִּישָׁא, אִמָּא דְּעֵרֶב רַב, שֶׁהִיא מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה

additions.reason: The 'harlot woman' is the active form of the evil feminine in this Torah — equated directly with Shifha Bisha and Malkhut haReshaya. She is the evil mirror of 'Isha Yirat Hashem' (Package 1). 'Neiuf hi Ervah, Elohim Acherim, Malkhut haReshaya.' Belongs in the evil kingdom package.
additions.source_quote: כִּי נִאוּף הִיא עֲרָיוֹת, אֱלֹקִים אֲחֵרִים, מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה

additions.reason: Black bile (mara shchorah) is equated with the spleen (טחול) — 'u-Mara Shchorah hi Techol' — and through that with Malkhut haReshaya. It is the physiological bechina of the evil kingdom, linked to sexual desire (the tears that come from the excess of black bile cleanse it). Belongs in the evil kingdom package.
additions.source_quote: כִּי אִיתָא, שֶׁהַדְּמָעוֹת הֵם מִמּוֹתְרוֹת הַמָּרָה שְׁחוֹרָה, וּמָרָה שְׁחוֹרָה הִיא טְחוֹל

additions.reason: Accepting the yoke of Heaven is described as bechina of the Holy Kingdom — it is the act by which a person includes himself in the 12 Tribes of Yah (Shivtei Yah) and separates from the evil maidservant. 'U-ve-Kabalat Ol Malkhut Shamayim, hu bechina Yam shel Shlomo.' Direct bechina with the Holy Kingdom package.
additions.source_quote: וּבְקַבָּלַת עֹל מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם, הוּא בְּחִינַת יָם שֶׁל שְׁלֹמֹה
